items.title: Campfire & Valley Gazing
items.description: Our communal firepit is stacked with premium teak and cedar wood reserves, spices, and roasted local delicacies prepared under the starry Jellippara skies.

items.title: Greeda’s Malabar Breakfast
items.description: Wake up to freshly-made traditional Malabar puttu, house-steamed bananas, pure forest honey, farm-fresh eggs, and hot Wayanad filter coffee.

items.title: High-Speed Forest Fiber
items.description: Though we encourage a full digital detox, rapid 500Mbps Starlink Wi-Fi is available in all rooms and courtyard areas should you need to stay in touch.

items.title: Attappadi River & Hill Trails
items.description: Direct trailhead access to the classic paths winding through neighboring valleys, crystal clear hill streams, and indigenous forest margins.
